PrintPut allows for a seamless integration of physical and interactive sketchings into the 3D printing process.
PrintPut is an interactive 3D printing system that embeds resistive and capacitive sensors directly into printed objects, without the requirement for external sensor hardware.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have designed a 3D printable conductive filament that can be used to create interactive widgets for physical interfaces, such as buttons, sliders, and touchpads, without the need of any external hardware.
PrintPut enables the interactive 3D printing of objects with embedded sensors.
we have developed a new 3D printing material, a new 3d printing process, a new 2D/3D design process, and a new 3rd dimension to interactive design.
